question: Which sodium compound is the most popular additive to various items such as sauces, salad dressings and beverages for Its preservative action?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sodium benzoate.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**Sodium benzoate is the sodium compound most commonly used as a preservative in items such as sauces, salad dressings, and beverages. Its excellent antimicrobial characteristics help extend the shelf life of foods and beverages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Sodium bicarbonate - Commonly known as baking soda, is primarily used in baking as a leavening agent.
 
• Sodium fluoride - It's widely used in toothpaste and drinking water to prevent tooth decay.
 
• Sodium hypochlorite - This is the active ingredient in bleach and is commonly used for disinfection and water treatment.
